# get_subset_atoms { #mofography.analyze.get_subset_atoms }

```python
analyze.get_subset_atoms(ase_atoms, subset)
```

Extract a bonded subgraph of ``ase_atoms`` as a new ASE Atoms object for the given atom indices.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                      | Default    |
|-----------|--------|----------------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms |        | the atoms object of the material | _required_ |
| subset    |        | a list of atom ids               | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The atoms object with the subset of atoms. |
